answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one ember weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The orchard report shows the merge explicitly at each pigment. Because of that, anyone who spins up 245 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 115 times the capital for one share. A farm of 2294 identities would post 927 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
